content.text: Confirmed — these two use `loading={!mounted}` purely as a hydration guard, not submission feedback, so their buttons show no spinner while actually submitting. That's now factored into the story below.

input.content:
## User Story: Consistent loading feedback on all forms

**As a** user submitting any form on the site (signing up, resetting a password, recording a game result, sending invoices, etc.)
**I want** the submit button to show a loading state while my submission is in flight
**So that** I get clear feedback that my action was registered and don't double-click or wonder if the app has stalled

### Background

Some forms already do this correctly — `ClaimSignup` and `SignIn` track a local `loading` boolean and pass it to the submit `Button` via `loading={loading}`; `GameResultForm` uses an equivalent `isSaving` flag. Per-row forms (`MoneyForm`, `ResponsesForm`) correctly scope loading to the specific row being saved (e.g. `loading={submittingPlayerId === row.player.id}`). This pattern should be extended to every remaining form so behaviour is consistent site-wide.

### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The submit button on each of the following forms shows `loading={true}` (via a Mantine `useForm`-compatible local state, following the `ClaimSignup`/`SignIn` pattern) for the duration of its submit handler, and is disabled while loading to prevent duplicate submissions:
  - [ ] [DeleteAccountForm.tsx](src/components/DeleteAccountForm/DeleteAccountForm.tsx)
  - [ ] [EnquiryForm.tsx](src/components/EnquiryForm/EnquiryForm.tsx)
  - [ ] [ForgottenPasswordForm.tsx](src/components/ForgottenPasswordForm/ForgottenPasswordForm.tsx)
  - [ ] [InvoiceForm.tsx](src/components/InvoiceForm/InvoiceForm.tsx)
  - [ ] [MoreGamesForm.tsx](src/components/MoreGamesForm/MoreGamesForm.tsx)
  - [ ] [NewPlayerForm.tsx](src/components/NewPlayerForm/NewPlayerForm.tsx)
  - [ ] [PasswordChangeForm.tsx](src/components/PasswordChangeForm/PasswordChangeForm.tsx)
  - [ ] [PasswordResetForm.tsx](src/components/PasswordResetForm/PasswordResetForm.tsx)
  - [ ] [PlayerProfileForm.tsx](src/components/PlayerProfileForm/PlayerProfileForm.tsx)
- [ ] `NewGameForm` and `GameInvitationResponseForm` currently pass `loading={!mounted}` to their submit buttons — a hydration guard, not submission feedback, so the spinner never appears during an actual submit. Replace/extend this so the button reflects both "not yet mounted" and "currently submitting" (e.g. `loading={!mounted || submitting}`):
  - [ ] [NewGameForm.tsx](src/components/NewGameForm/NewGameForm.tsx)
  - [ ] [GameInvitationResponseForm.tsx](src/components/GameInvitationResponseForm/GameInvitationResponseForm.tsx)
- [ ] `MoneyForm` and `ResponsesForm` are out of scope — their per-row `loading={submittingPlayerId === row.player.id}` / `loading={savingId === row.playerId}` patterns already give correct, scoped feedback per submit action.
- [ ] Loading state is reset (`loading`/`isSaving` set back to `false`) in a `finally` block or equivalent, so the button never gets stuck in a loading state if the submission throws or the server action returns an error.
- [ ] No change to existing success/error `notifications.show(...)` calls — this story is additive, not a replacement for the notification-based feedback already present.
- [ ] Unit/component tests updated or added per form to assert the button enters a loading state on submit and clears it afterwards (success and error paths), consistent with the project's testing conventions (`*.vitest.spec.tsx`, `getByRole` selectors).

### Out of scope

- Introducing a shared hook/HOC to reduce duplication across forms (worth a follow-up if the per-form `useState` pattern feels repetitive once applied consistently).

content.text:
## User story: Consistent loading feedback on all forms

**As a** user submitting any form on the site
**I want** the submit button to show a loading state while my submission is in flight
**So that** I get clear feedback that my action was registered and don't double-click or wonder if the app has stalled

### Background
`ClaimSignup` and `SignIn` already do this right — a local `loading` boolean fed into `Button loading={loading}`. `GameResultForm` has the equivalent `isSaving`. `MoneyForm` and `ResponsesForm` correctly scope loading per-row (`loading={submittingPlayerId === row.player.id}`). Everything else needs the same treatment.

### Acceptance criteria

**Forms with no submission loading state at all** — add it, following the `ClaimSignup`/`SignIn` pattern:
- [DeleteAccountForm.tsx](src/components/DeleteAccountForm/DeleteAccountForm.tsx)
- [EnquiryForm.tsx](src/components/EnquiryForm/EnquiryForm.tsx)
- [ForgottenPasswordForm.tsx](src/components/ForgottenPasswordForm/ForgottenPasswordForm.tsx)
- [InvoiceForm.tsx](src/components/InvoiceForm/InvoiceForm.tsx)
- [MoreGamesForm.tsx](src/components/MoreGamesForm/MoreGamesForm.tsx)
- [NewPlayerForm.tsx](src/components/NewPlayerForm/NewPlayerForm.tsx)
- [PasswordChangeForm.tsx](src/components/PasswordChangeForm/PasswordChangeForm.tsx)
- [PasswordResetForm.tsx](src/components/PasswordResetForm/PasswordResetForm.tsx)
- [PlayerProfileForm.tsx](src/components/PlayerProfileForm/PlayerProfileForm.tsx)

**Forms with a mislabelled `loading` prop** — currently `loading={!mounted}` is a hydration guard, so the spinner never shows during an actual submit. Extend to `loading={!mounted || submitting}`:
- [NewGameForm.tsx](src/components/NewGameForm/NewGameForm.tsx)
- [GameInvitationResponseForm.tsx](src/components/GameInvitationResponseForm/GameInvitationResponseForm.tsx)

**Out of scope:** `MoneyForm` and `ResponsesForm` — their per-row loading is already correct.

**Other criteria:**
- Loading state must reset in a `finally` (or equivalent) so a thrown error/failed action never leaves the button stuck spinning.
- No change to existing `notifications.show(...)` success/error feedback — additive only.
- Tests added/updated per form asserting loading state on submit and clearing on both success and error paths.

I found and verified this by grepping every `useForm` component for a `loading`/`isSubmitting` pattern and checking each submit `Button` directly, so the checklist reflects actual current state rather than assumption. Saved to [loading-feedback-user-story.md](../../../../private/tmp/claude-501/-Volumes-Development-next-www-toastboy/bec31651-6c56-4392-a992-dca44f487775/scratchpad/loading-feedback-user-story.md) — let me know if you'd like it filed as a Jira issue or trimmed down.
